instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Community health foundation running maternal and child health programs, vaccination campaigns, and nutrition interventions in underserved urban communities. The organization manages complex compliance requirements related to public health data and grant funding, demanding meticulous documentation.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: Due to strict government reporting requirements and donor mandates, rapid scaling of new initiatives is difficult. The current informal structure struggles to quickly pivot when regulatory changes or funding opportunities arise.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Optimized Service Delivery Model Expansion (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing community health worker networks to introduce high-demand niche services like specialized dietary counseling or mental health triage, expanding the scope of service without requiring entirely new infrastructure.

first_actions: Conduct a needs assessment for two identified niche health services.
Develop a pilot curriculum and staffing plan for one service line.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase non-core service revenue by 10% within 6 months.
milestones: Full rollout of the new model: Month 4

opportunities.title: Data-Driven Telehealth Platform (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Given the low digital maturity and high competitive pressure, develop a proprietary, secure telehealth platform specifically designed for underserved areas. This radical shift moves beyond simple tracking to offer scalable remote consultation services.

first_actions: Partner with one tech startup for initial MVP framework.
Allocate dedicated engineering talent and define regulatory compliance pathway.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 2,000 active telehealth users within 1 year.
milestones: MVP launch and regulatory review start: Month 3

opportunities.title: Strategic Grant Diversification (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Focus on aggressively pursuing funding from three new, non-traditional sources (e.g., corporate CSR funds or international development banks) to reduce reliance on single large clients.

first_actions: Assign a dedicated grant writing coordinator.
Map all potential new funding streams.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure three major, non-corporate grants totaling $1M by end of year.
milestones: First successful grant application submission: Quarter 2

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, streamlined 'Innovation Sandbox' within the current informal structure to test radical ideas quickly.
Audit existing talent and identify high-potential individuals for specialized training in digital tools necessary for the Telehealth platform.
Formalize a dedicated regulatory compliance track within the decision-making committee specifically for high-risk, bold initiatives.

key_weaknesses: Fragmented project tracking and inconsistent adoption of technology across teams.
Over-reliance on a single product category and highly concentrated customer base, increasing market risk.
Informal innovation process leading to slow decision-making cycles and lack of structured change management.
Limited digital maturity (Level 2) hindering the ability to leverage modern data analytics for proactive service scaling.
